Dialogs.Dialog: ▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
I want to get some new clothes, so I thought I'd ask your opinion.
I don't think that kind of thing suits me much.
But when the base is this good, simple clothes keep it balanced！
Hey, I was asking you seriously... So, casual style, eh？
No, no！ You know, frilly, fluffy stuff. Very ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Isn't that a bit childish now？
Something neat and ladylike suits ▲高嶺＊＊▲ best.
I'm not a "young lady" or anything like that.
Sorry. But I think something a little graceful suits ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Sometimes, you know... How do I put it？
Something with a little less fabric, you know.
Like mini-skirts or something of that sort？
Right？ No waste, and eco-friendly too.
Don't get ahead of yourself... Pervert.
Actually, I like you just as you are. As your boyfriend.
I see, hmm... Then maybe I'll stay this way. As your girlfriend. Hehe▼
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
I want to get some new clothes. What kind do you like？
Yeah, I get it, but... I'm plain, so I'd just look even plainer.
Really. Actually, better not say that to your friends.
You know, the kind you wore a lot before we started going out.
Ah, that kind... Yeah. But it's a little childish now.
Not at all. The ▲高嶺＊＊▲ I met is still the ▲高嶺＊＊▲ I love.
Yes... If you say so, I'd like that too.
(Too corny？ But cute is best for ▲高嶺＊＊▲！)
Something neat and ladylike suits ▲高嶺＊＊▲ best.
I'm not a "young lady" or anything...
I see. But I think something a little graceful suits ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Do you think so... I hope it suits me the way you imagine...
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is all about neat and graceful！)
Sometimes, maybe... How do I put it？ Something that doesn't waste fabric？
Um... Less fabric, maybe？ Shorter hems？
Do you mean... miniskirts, that kind of thing？
It's not no good... but do you promise not to look at me in a pervy way？
Of course, from a boyfriend's point of view, the style you're wearing now looks good.
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
I'm thinking of getting new clothes. If you have any requests, tell me？
I just think an active look suits ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
I've kind of wanted to try that too... You won't be disappointed if it doesn't suit me？
Hehe, okay, then I'll give it a try？
(Casual's the best. I won't have to worry about it either！)
I like cute clothes. They're so ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
The kind ▲高嶺＊＊▲ wore a lot when we first met.
I get it, but... they're a little childish, so I thought maybe you liked a different style.
Everything looks good, but cute suits you. It's so ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Thank you. I'm happy to hear that.
What about something neat？ Elegant, I guess？
As a guy, neat and graceful is the ideal, you know. Yeah.
Is that how it is. But... would it suit me？
Okay, then I'll try it. Hehe▼
Sometimes, maybe... An adventure？ Something a little more grown-up？
You could say that... Less fabric？ Shorter hems？
Do you mean... really short minis, or something that shows my belly button？
Yeah, well. As one form of expression？
That's a little embarrassing... Is that what you want？
Actually, I like you as you are. I like ▲高嶺＊＊▲ like that.
Really. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is fine as is.
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
I'm thinking of changing my hair a little. What do you think？
Long really is best for ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Really？ Hmm... I guess it is.
▲高嶺＊＊▲ has that classic heroine image.
Right. And heroines are required to have silky long hair.
That's silly. But... Yeah, maybe long is best.
How do I put it, it's lively, friendly, approachable？ And it'd be a change of image.
So I'm plain, stuck-up, and unapproachable, then.
(I made her mad... But short is the best！)
Short is nice, but long is so ▲高嶺＊＊▲. So I split the difference.
But I can style it lots of ways... Yes, maybe that's good.
I like the length it is now. I love ▲高嶺＊＊▲ with that hairstyle.
Hmm... I see. Then I'll keep it like this a little longer.
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
I think it's time to change my hair a little. What do you like？
I guess because my first impression of ▲高嶺＊＊▲ stuck with me.
Your long hair swaying and sparkling, and I thought, "Wow, she's beautiful."
I also like long hair. I'm very glad to hear you say that.
"Pretty" is nice too, but with short hair, ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s cuteness really shows？
Oh, you're just biased. We're going out, after all.
I don't know, I think anyone would say you're cute！
Yes. But for me, it's enough if just you think so. ...Just saying.
Let's see... I'll go with medium-length.
Short is nice, but ▲高嶺＊＊▲ means long hair. Sorry, that's just my male ego.
I'm happier when you tell me all kinds of things. Maybe it means you love me that much... Just kidding.
I like the length it is now. I like ▲高嶺＊＊▲ like that.
Okay. I thought you might get tired of it... Then I'll keep it？
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
Hey？ I'm thinking of changing my hairstyle a little. Any requests？
I like ▲高嶺＊＊▲ with long hair best.
When we first met, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ had long hair, right？
Yes. I've been growing it for a long time.
Your long hair was swaying and sparkling, and I thought, "Wow, she's beautiful."
Geez... You always say things like that. But I'm happy.
People sometimes see ▲高嶺＊＊▲ as a proper "young lady," right？
But really, you're friendly and energetic, the type short hair suits, I think.
...Thank you. I'm really happy to hear you say that. I want to be a girl like what you described.
All right！ Takane, the athlete, takes on the short-hair challenge！
Let's see... I'll go with medium-length.
Well, short is nice, but long is so "THE ▲高嶺＊＊▲," I can't pick either...
Is it？ It's a solution, isn't it？
Okaaay. Then I'll try that. Hehe▼
I like the length it is now. I like ▲高嶺＊＊▲ like that.
Then I'll keep it. If you think it's "good," that's good for me. ...Just kidding. Hehe▼
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
Hey, what was your favorite food again？ Just to check？
Sweet potatoes, of course！ Same as ▲高嶺＊＊▲, right？
Sweet potatoes？ Um... Yes, I like them？
I've been hooked lately too. They're so good！
They're good. But sweet potato dishes... Hmm...
Japanese food. As a Japanese guy, something light！
Nothing！ I love it too. Anything you don't like？
Udon, soba, gyudon, katsudon, tendon... Nope, nothing！
Huh？ Um... Japanese food is fine, right？
Western-style, I guess. Young guys need ketchup and sauce！
Ketchup and sauce？ Like a Western-style diner？
Oh, nice！ Omelet rice, Napolitan spaghetti.
I like Chinese food！ It's oily, and you get that "Ahh, I ate！" feeling！
Well, it keeps you full, you know？
Does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ not like Chinese food？
I do？ But oily food, once it gets cold... Hmm...
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
Hey, if we went somewhere together, what kind of place would you want to go？
Calm and quiet places, I guess.
Somewhere quiet, where we can relax？
Yeah, like that. In a place like that, we could take it easy together, right？
Hehe. Somewhere calm, huh？ I'll remember that.
Anywhere I can exercise, I guess.
In a place like that, we can goof around and it's fine, right？
Okay, got it. I'll remember that.
I thought that's a bit outside my comfort zone.
No, but I'll try. Trendy places, huh？
Anywhere I can play, I guess.
Well, honestly, as long as ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is there, anywhere's...
Hehe, but okay. I'll remember that？
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
Hey, what kind of places do you want to go with me？
Calm and quiet places, I guess.
Hehe. It's nice to relax, isn't it？
Exactly. I can talk with ▲高嶺＊＊▲ at my own pace, too.
...Yes. I think I like places like that too.
Anywhere I can exercise, I guess.
Hehe, I think I get it.
Places to move around, huh？ I'll remember...
Um... The kind that end up in magazines？
Hehe. With you, I think I'd really enjoy it.
Anywhere I can play, I guess.
Yeah. Somewhere I can really cut loose with ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
With you, I bet it'd be fun...
Places where you can play, huh？ I'll keep that in mind...
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
Hey, a question. If we went on a date, where would you want to go？
Calm and quiet places, I guess.
Well, because I can relax with ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
The question mark at the end is unnecessary.
Hehe, but got it. Calm places, huh？
Anywhere I can exercise, I guess.
Hehe, are you sure？ Saying something like that.
Okay, but got it. Places to move around, huh？
Yeah, yeah. I want us to conquer them together, you know.
Hehe, right. We could make lots of memories...
Mm, got it. Trendy places, huh？
Anywhere I can play, I guess.
Hehe, geez. Of course not, right？
Places to have fun, huh？ Roger▼
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
Hey, when you're on your own, where do you go？
Calm and quiet places, I guess.
Hmm... Because you can't relax when you're with me？
Hehe, kidding. You panicked too much.
Anywhere I can exercise, I guess.
Well, partly... though I'm not really the stressed type.
Anywhere I can play, I guess.
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
Hey, where do you go when you're by yourself？
Calm and quiet places, I guess.
I see... You need time like that too, right？
Exactly, somewhere I can breathe easy.
Anywhere I can exercise, I guess.
Yeah, kind of like self-training, in a way.
Hehe, you're full of energy, huh？
Isn't it lonely going to places like that alone？
I'm fine. It's more like date research anyway.
Anywhere I can play, I guess.
Like playing all out to refresh yourself？
I see. Maybe I'll try it if I get the chance？
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
Hey, where do you go when you're on your own？
Calm and quiet places, I guess.
Yeah, to find a different side of myself...
Hehe, geez, you're making that up.
Anywhere I can exercise, I guess.
I can focus, and I sleep like a log at night.
Hmm... Maybe I'll disturb you next time？ Disturb your sleep.
Hehe, kidding. Places to move around, huh...
Hmm... Hey, are you doing research for me？
Hehe, maybe I'll look forward to our next date？
Anywhere I can play, I guess.
That's not some weird kind of fun, right？
I see, places to have fun, huh...
Hey... What's your "type"？ Of girl, I mean.
Kind and quiet... Yes, of course.
I wish I could be kinder too.
Cheerful and outgoing. I see. Hmm...
Huh？ Did I say something weird？
Why？ That's your preference, isn't it？ Kind and cheerful, was it？
But I'm going out with ▲高嶺＊＊▲ because I like her.
Huh？ Did I say something weird？
Hey, can I ask what type of girl you like？
Cool and quiet, I guess. Yeah.
Well, maybe. Kind of intellectual, mysterious？
I see... I think people like that are wonderful too... but...
Being cold to you is impossible. Because I already... about you...
No. I see. I have to try harder！
Cheerful and outgoing... I see... Yes. But...
No. But wouldn't you think a girl like that is... improper？
Like, if I were... more, um...
If ▲高嶺＊＊▲ made the first move？
Geez... I'm asking seriously, you know？
Well, I like ▲高嶺＊＊▲, that's why we're going out.
I love that kind side of you. ...Just saying.
A little cool, the quiet type, I guess？
Huh？ Did I say something weird？
It's not that, but you... that's why I...
Geez... Why does it end up like this？
Hmm... So you like quiet girls.
A proper, demure Japanese girl, of course. Bashful, you know？ That's great, yeah.
I do think I'm a little improper. But it's partly you who makes me that way...
Actually, I'd go with ▲高嶺＊＊▲ as she is now？
Geez... You're such a smooth talker.
I'm telling the truth, you know.
Yes... Then I'll try even harder. Is that okay？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ as she is now is the best.)
What has ▲高嶺＊＊▲ been up to at home lately？
Flopping onto my bed. Hugging my pillow.
Huh... Sounds like you'd fall asleep like that.
What does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ do at home？
Lately, I read magazines to check out clothes, play with my hair...
Yeah, a little. I didn't think you'd buy that kind of thing.
Yes... Before I met you, I wasn't very interested, I guess.
So ▲高嶺＊＊▲, could it be you did it for me...？
...Let's go look at magazines together sometime？ I want to know more about what you like.
What has ▲高嶺＊＊▲ been up to at home lately？
Lately... I've been thinking while playing piano.
Thinking while playing!? Isn't that hard？
Depends on the person？ I can't with hard pieces, but with ones I know well, I can even chat？
Huh... So what are you thinking about？
All sorts of things. Including you.
Hmm, who knows？ I'll play piano when I get home today too▼
What has ▲高嶺＊＊▲ been up to at home lately？
The other day Mama bought this amazing sponge. Since then I've been cleaning a lot.
Yes. It takes off tea stains really well, but what surprised me even more was...
It keeps getting smaller as you use it！ That's what's fun.
But I might not be able to anymore.
I was scrubbing everything too hard and Mama scolded me. Especially the floor, since I turned one spot white...
(Once ▲高嶺＊＊▲ gets hooked, she goes all the way...)
▲主人公＊▲. Can I ask just one thing？
Hey, have you been oversleeping lately？ Are you a morning person？
Mornings？ Let's see... I'm more of a...
I guess I'm good with mornings？
Right！ The early bird gets the worm！
I guess I'm not great with mornings？
I knew it. If you don't wake up properly, you'll be spaced out all day, right？
I know, but it's not that easy.
No good. You have to do something about it. Okay？
Nope. I'll help too, so you'll get up properly. Okay？
Right. Battle-ready from the morning. That's the basics of a successful man.
You don't have to be a successful man...
Not to brag, but I'm a total night owl！
Then getting up in the morning must be hard, right？
Pretty much. Actually, I can't get up. Wake me up.
Geez, getting carried away. Then if I help, will you get up properly？ Well？
